QuestInfo.name: For a New Start
QuestInfo.0: Regarding Rami, #b#p3006530##k has a request for you. Listen to him in #b#m410007607##k.
QuestInfo.1: Ropa is planning a memorial ceremony to celebrate the lives of the fallen, and pave the way for a new era. To help, defeat the Specters in #bAmong Tainted Trees#k and gather the Snake warriors' keepsakes.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the keepsakes of the Snake warriors for Ropa. He's invited the Turtle Anima to the ceremony. It looks like #bEto#k needs help in preparing for her tribe's part.
